en.headline: Handmade Hong Kong market closes Sunday at Discovery Bay
en.dek: The two-day weekend stall at DB Plaza, with about 80 local makers, runs until 6pm today after opening at 11am on Saturday.
body: Handmade Hong Kong’s September Discovery Bay Weekend Market is in its second and final day at DB Plaza on Discovery Bay Road. The organiser lists the hours as 11am to 6pm on both Saturday and Sunday.

The organiser’s event page names about 80 participating stalls. They include ceramics, jewellery, leather goods, prints, vintage clothing, skincare and other small-batch crafts, as well as food stalls selling items such as XO sauce, chilli products, kombucha and wine.

Discovery Bay Plaza is served by ferry from Central and by bus from Tung Chung. The market is an outdoor weekend fixture organised by Handmade Hong Kong rather than a government programme. Stall lists and any weather changes are published on the organiser’s site.
Sunday is the last session of this edition. The organiser has not announced a follow-up date at the same plaza in the same listing.

zh.headline: Handmade Hong Kong周末市集週日於愉景灣收官
zh.dek: 9月愉景灣周末市集在DB Plaza舉行，約80個本地手作攤位，周六已開檔，今日開至下午6時。
body: Handmade Hong Kong舉辦的9月愉景灣周末市集今日踏入第二天，亦是今輪最後一天，地點在愉景灣道DB Plaza。主辦單位公布的開放時間為周六及週日上午11時至下午6時。
主辦單位活動頁列出約80個攤位，包括陶瓷、首飾、皮革、版畫、古著、護膚等手作，以及XO醬、辣椒製品、紅茶菌及葡萄酒等食品攤檔。
市民可乘中環開出的渡輪，或由東涌乘巴士前往愉景灣廣場。市集由Handmade Hong Kong主辦，並非政府活動。攤檔名單及天氣安排以主辦單位公布為準。
今日為今輪市集最後一場，同一活動頁未有公布下一檔在同一廣場的日期。
